billing.title: Billing & Plans
billing.subtitle: Manage your subscription and view usage
billing.faq1Answer: Yes — you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes apply at the next billing cycle.
billing.faq2: What happens when I exceed my plan limits?
billing.faq2Answer: You'll see a warning, and certain actions may be temporarily blocked until you upgrade or stay within limits.
billing.faq3: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
billing.faq3Answer: Most paid plans come with a short trial period. Check the plan card for details.
billing.faq4: How do I cancel my subscription?
billing.faq4Answer: Use "Manage Billing" above to cancel anytime. Your access continues until the end of the current period.
